title: Google Pairs Antigravity With Gemini 3.7 Flash for Multi-Agent Math and Engineering Work
dek: Google says Gemini 3.7 Flash is powering autonomous agent teams in Antigravity for open mathematics, CPU emulation and open-source optimization tasks.
socialCaption: Google says Antigravity agent teams, powered by Gemini 3.7 Flash, are being used for open math problems, CPU emulators and open-source optimization. The bigger business question: how reliably can coordinated agents fit into real engineering workflows?
